    input Cin,
    input clk, // Added the clk input
    output reg [15:0] S,
    output reg Cout
);reg [15:0] P, G, C1, C2;

always @ (posedge clk) begin
    P <= A ^ B;           // Update P on clk edge
    G <= A & B;           // Update G on clk edge
